This site publishes project reports for the Lean formalization of conditional admissibility judgments. The reports are authored in Quarto inside this repository, rendered to HTML for local review, and deployed to GitHub Pages for stable public linking.

::: {.callout-note}
## Publishing model

The public site is built from the `reports/` directory. Pushing changes to `main` triggers the GitHub Pages workflow, which renders the Quarto site and publishes the generated HTML.
:::

## Available reports

| Report | Focus |
|---|---|
| [Foundations of Conditional Admissibility](01-foundations-overview.qmd) | Natural-language overview of the core Lean structures, expected-utility representation, and the verified Bool example. |

## Adding a new report

1. Add a new `.qmd` file in `reports/`.
2. Render or preview locally with `quarto render reports --to html` or `quarto preview reports`.
3. Add the new report to the table above so it appears on the landing page.
4. Push to `main` to publish the updated site through GitHub Pages.
